purpose: bounded mechanism discrimination; deterministic numerical substitute, no LLM API

reserve_fixture.name: mcm593
reserve_fixture.only_if: pilot diversity insufficient; otherwise not run

pool: expanded arithmetic constants+published proposal replay, same frozen native graph per fixture
novelty: no duplicate canonical tagged RTL within an arm; bounded e-node exclusion search, maximum64 subproblems per query
fixed: uniform fixed operation costs; next-best structural extraction subject to previously emitted RTL exclusion
random: seeded node costs from [0.25,1,3,10], no response dependence; same novelty constraint
openloop: largest coefficient selected MUL else ADD; always+3; no response/history dependence; persistent costs, no outer resets
numerical: cell-source provenance attribution, fractionally split multi-source cells; target max(0.25,attributed_gates/width); update selected nodes up/down; reject worsening gate count via cost-state rollback before successor extraction; forbid repeats by same novelty constraint
attribution_gate: cone mapped-cell fraction>=0.6 and named-node fraction>=0.8
evaluation: algorithm final candidate and external best gates with paired depth/pointIDs reported separately; no netlist equivalence claim
pruning: fixed graph and model preflight must offer >=6 distinct structural extractions; no unbounded sweep; reserve fixture only if predefined criterion fails
attribution_revision: cell src provenance pilot coverage0: route pruned. Named-wire-boundary cone partition replaces it before comparison; no new synthesis needed for reanalysis of existing pilot.
